shared.name: theme
shared.codeNote: Decorative colour name, not a semantic status.

shared.name: value
shared.codeNote: The tag's text, and the only required prop.

codeOnly.name: label
codeOnly.notes: Passing label *and* value switches rendering to an internal two-tag split composite: label on the left, value on the right.

codeOnly.name: icon
codeOnly.notes: An IconV2 name, rendered at size 'xs' before the text.

codeOnly.name: iconProps
codeOnly.notes: An IconPropsV2 object passed through to IconV2, excluding name, size, fallback and ref.

codeOnly.name: actionIcon
codeOnly.notes: An IconV2 name rendered inside a transparent icon-only Button after the text — the dismiss/remove affordance.

codeOnly.name: onClick
codeOnly.notes: Inherited from React.HTMLAttributes rather than declared, so it does not appear in TagProps' own members.

codeOnly.name: enableHover
codeOnly.notes: Applies hover styling to a non-clickable tag.

codeOnly.name: rounded
codeOnly.notes: Switches the corner radius from the default to a full pill.

codeOnly.name: disabled
codeOnly.notes: Visual and cursor state only — it is not a CVA variant and sets no aria-disabled.

codeOnly.name: title
codeOnly.notes: Native tooltip on the text span, defaulting to title || value || label so truncated text is always recoverable on hover.

codeOnly.name: className
codeOnly.notes: Additional classes on the tag root, or on the split wrapper in split mode.

codeOnly.name: labelClassName
codeOnly.notes: Classes for the left half of a split tag.

codeOnly.name: valueClassName
codeOnly.notes: Classes for the right half of a split tag.
